purpose: Define the project research scope, objective hierarchy, ablation registry, current boundaries, and decision logic.
source_of_truth_role: Research objective and scope registry; not a raw experiment ledger.

in_scope: Cross-subject emotion recognition within each dataset.
DEAP and I-DARE as the main datasets.
Binary valence and binary arousal classification.
EEG-only, EMG-only, and EEG+EMG fusion after readiness.
Dataset-aware modeling when the dataset structure justifies it.
I-DARE trial-aware BSL/STIM modeling through STIM-BSL and compact BSL-stats ablations.
DEAP temporal modeling of 12 x 5s windows inside each 60s trial.
Controlled ablations of representation, label policy, architecture, augmentation, and regularization.
out_of_scope_current: Cross-dataset transfer between DEAP and I-DARE.
Final paper-level performance claims from smoke runs.
EEG+EMG fusion before single-modality readiness and comparison.
Full paired model(BSL, STIM, STIM-BSL) before low-capacity BSL-stats evidence is interpreted.
Locking midpoint_as_high as the final label policy before label-policy ablation.
Promoting raw EMG to mainline without evidence against feature-level EMG.

long_term_objectives.title: Quantify EMG value added to EEG
long_term_objectives.definition: Test whether EMG improves cross-subject emotion recognition when combined with EEG.
long_term_objectives.success_evidence: Controlled EEG-only, EMG-only, and EEG+EMG evaluations under fixed protocol.

long_term_objectives.title: Build reproducible EEG/EMG pipelines for DEAP and I-DARE
long_term_objectives.definition: Create cache-backed, documented, reproducible pipelines for EEG-only, EMG-only, and multimodal experiments.
long_term_objectives.success_evidence: Reusable scripts, reports, frozen status docs, and central roadmap updates.

long_term_objectives.title: Use dataset structure responsibly
long_term_objectives.definition: Do not force DEAP and I-DARE into identical modeling assumptions when their trial structures differ.
long_term_objectives.success_evidence: DEAP sequence modeling and I-DARE BSL/STIM-aware ablations are evaluated separately.

long_term_objectives.title: Reach defensible final evaluation
long_term_objectives.definition: Move from smoke/stabilization to broader/full evaluation and eventually final LOSO only after stability.
long_term_objectives.success_evidence: Explicit transition from smoke to full/broader testing and documented decisions.

medium_term_objectives.title: Determine current I-DARE EEG and EMG mainline representations
Compare EMG raw waveform and feature-level representations
Evaluate I-DARE BSL-aware modeling
medium_term_objectives.status: BSL-stats smoke frozen; direct comparison still needed

medium_term_objectives.title: Evaluate DEAP temporal sequence modeling
medium_term_objectives.status: planned/not started in current frozen roadmap

ablation_registry.activation_rule: Run only under fixed splits, seeds, recipes, and metrics.
Run after baseline windowing path is stable.
Run after DEAP single-modality baselines are established.
Run as controlled ablations only after a stable EEG baseline exists.
Feature-level EMG remains mainline unless controlled evidence changes it.
Full paired model is allowed only after BSL-stats evidence is compared against STIM-BSL-only baselines.
Run only after a stable baseline and with augmentation leakage checks.
Run only after baseline/fusion readiness; positive pairs must respect affective response, not stimulus identity alone.

current_priority_filter: Do not start an ablation unless it is linked to a medium-term objective.
Do not run an ablation if the result cannot change a decision.
Do not start fusion before single-modality readiness is documented.
Prefer direct comparison docs before adding new model families.
Treat planned ablations as registry items, not permission to run them immediately.
current_next_allowed_focus: Directly compare BSL-stats ablations against corresponding STIM-BSL-only baselines for EEG and EMG.
Keep fusion not-started until this comparison is documented.
Keep label policy open for future controlled ablation.
